title: Photography
slide_intent: Teach designers to reserve space in a photograph for the story it must carry. Subject focus and room for type affect how quickly a viewer connects image and research.
strategic_value: CSAIL can explain specific work with recognizable photography and consistent identifying marks, even when the images come from different settings.
demonstration: Two image pairs compare source photographs with finished treatments: a portrait becomes a ColorMod graphic, and multicolored gloves are rearranged around copy on black.
practical_value: Choose a single subject, consider where type will sit, and use a darker treatment or a neutral field when the original image leaves too little contrast.

content_islands.name: Photography guidance
content_islands.spec: Give the left column to subject focus, contrast, neutral grounds and image-credit instructions.

content_islands.name: Portrait comparison
content_islands.spec: Place the untreated portrait at top left of the image field and its titled treatment to the right.
